source.notes: GET /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints/1 (a specific watchpoint id in the path, distinct from the collection route GET /debugger/watchpoints already covered by watchpoint-list-after-hit). Answers 200 with the <dbg:watchpoints> list root carrying the one row for watchpoint 1 (LV_TOTAL). Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
